note: The scheduler fires at delivery_time on the COMPUTER'S LOCAL clock — there is no per-task timezone. Right now the cron '0 7 * * *' fires at 07:00 Singapore. When you move your Mac's clock to Italy (Europe/Rome), the same cron automatically becomes 07:00 Rome — no change needed. If you ever want 7am in a timezone DIFFERENT from your Mac's clock, ask Claude to recompute the cron (e.g. 7am Rome while on Singapore time = '0 13 * * *').
